name: Prismella Leadglass
description: Heavy leading and patterned panes. Every shape is split into cells and filled with something different.

designs.title: Rose Window
designs.description: A round church window of petals and patterned panes. Fills a whole shoulder blade.

designs.title: Glass Butterfly
designs.description: A butterfly with heavily leaded wings, panes of black, hatching and dots radiating out.

designs.title: Lancet Lily
designs.description: A lily rising in a pointed arch against a diamond lattice. Tall and thin, made for the forearm.

designs.title: Glass Fish
designs.description: A round fish made of honeycomb panes, with a plain head and one very surprised eye.

designs.title: Glass Heart
designs.description: A heart cut into a wheel of leaded panes around a small black star. Fragile on purpose.

designs.title: Sunrise Window
designs.description: A black sun coming up over two hills, with rays of patterned glass above it.
